analysis.title: GS Bailey - US Equities Mid Day Color 15 Oct 2026
key_insights: SPX recovered to unchanged and is holding the 50-day moving average (7707) as the tape broadens, with 355 names green. S&P ex AI (SPXXAI) is up 135bps and RTY is outperforming SPX, with its second largest dispersion since July.
The GS AI Basket (GSTMTAIP) is down 270bps on the day and down 12% over the past 7 sessions. Quality (GSP1QUAL) is up 55bps and up 15% over the last month.

The tape has a strong defensive tilt. Discretionary (GSXUCOND) +300bps, Health Care (GSXUHLTH) +225bps, Communications (GSXUCOMS) +200bps, Staples (GSXUSTAP) +190bps and Financials (GSXUFINA) +135bps all moved about 1.5 standard deviations.
The broadening out is hurting hedge funds. The HF VIP Long/Short Pair (GSTHVIPP) is down 115bps on the day and down 10% since the drawdown began on Oct 8.
Global AI stocks (GSXGGLAI constituents) saw the second largest net selling in the past year on Oct 14, after July (-2.8 Z score). Long and short sales ran 3.5 to 1, per GS PB.

GS's AI sentiment indicator has been negative for 6 straight weeks, with its lowest reading of -1.3 as of Friday. Overall length is not max long. The AI trade is still long but is now about 6 out of 10 in length, much cleaner than in June/July.
GS flows were busiest in TMT at the start of the day and have since slowed. GS has net sold $10.5bn in TMT over the past 6 sessions.
Liquidity: exchange volumes are +45% vs the 20-day average and SPX volumes are +37%. ETFs are 31% of the tape, with top-of-book liquidity of $8.3mm on the touch.

GS flows: activity is 6 out of 10, with the floor skewed to sale (15% sell skew). Long-only clients show a 40% sell skew on large notional, concentrated in info tech (70% sell skew). The only buy tickets are in staples.
Hedge funds are balanced and broadly degrossing, with aggressive covering in consumer early in the session.
Chart of the Day: TMT selling has been violent. The GS broad AI basket (GSTMTAIP) is down 20% over the past 5 sessions, toward the lower end of recent unwind episodes.
risk_factors: Continued AI and TMT unwind: the AI basket is down 12% over 7 sessions and 20% over 5 sessions by the report's two measures.
Hedge fund degrossing is pressuring crowded long/short pairs as the market broadens.
vol_and_positioning: GS PB data shows Global AI stocks had the second largest net selling in the past year on Oct 14 (-2.8 Z score), with long and short sales at 3.5 to 1.
The GS AI sentiment indicator has been negative for 6 straight weeks and read -1.3 as of Friday, its lowest. AI length is about 6 out of 10, not max long.
The HF VIP Long/Short Pair (GSTHVIPP) is down 10% since the drawdown began on Oct 8 as hedge funds degross.
GS has net sold $10.5bn in TMT over the past 6 sessions.
Long-only supply is concentrated in info tech with a 70% sell skew, while hedge funds are balanced with broad degrossing and aggressive consumer covering.
